purpose: An overview page: a header row with title, filters and actions, a row of KPI tiles, the main content and an optional aside.

props.name: filters
props.description: Search, date range and filter controls in the header row

props.name: actions
props.description: Page actions such as Export, in the header row

props.name: kpis
props.description: KPI tiles, one Card each; they wrap on narrow screens

props.name: aside
props.description: Secondary content beside the main content

whenToUse: Overview and analytics pages, and any page whose header needs search, a date range or filters
whenNotToUse: A page that exists to complete a form — use FormPage
antiPatterns: Filters scattered through the content instead of the header row
More than one primary action in the header row

anatomy: Header row: title, description, filters, actions
sizes: Container full; KPI tiles at least `size-grid-item-sm`; gaps `layout-gutter-lg`, `space-layout-section`

a11yNotes: Filters come before the content they filter, in source order

slots.name: title
slots.description: What the page is an overview of. Example: Overview.

slots.name: filters
slots.description: Each control labelled; a date range as two labelled dates or one range control.

slots.name: actions
slots.description: At most one contained action; others outlined.

slots.name: kpis
slots.description: Tiles with a label, a value and its period. Example: Balance, £12,400, today.
